integrity: Complete proof and three independently structured standalone finite checks are included; experiments supplement but do not replace general proof. No independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to 3-divisible Hamming alphabet sizes and finite fields of characteristic three; it does not address nonlinear or graph-automorphism-quotiented states. Historical priority cannot be conclusively established: the subsequent Yoshikawa (2004) journal text and the Macfarlane (2004) full article remain uninspected; Yoshikawa's January 2003 six-page symposium proceeding has been inspected in full.
title: A three-class wave clock and exact orbit census for ternary-modular Hamming graphs
